Jos saavut myöhään, sinun ei tarvitse jännittää, että annetaanko huoneesi pois, koska emme ikinä ylibuukkaa. Sinulla on yksityisyytesi ja voit olla oma itsesi – ei respaa, ei arvioivia katseita. Ja mikä ehkä hauskinta, voit kertoa kokeneesi jotain ainutlaatuista.  Kun valitset Omenan, tiedät aina tismalleen mitä saat. Hotellimme sijaitsevat aina keskustassa, aina kunnon sänky, aina huoneita kolmelle ja neljälle sekä aina oma kylppäri. Jokaisessa huoneessa on omia eväitä varten mikro, jääkaappi ja vedenkeitin ja toisaalta vinkit kaupungin parhaisiin ravintoloihin. Company description: Klaus K Hotel is located in the heart and center of Helsinki. We are the first Preferred Hotels & Resorts property in Finland. Name: Ranuan Kunta
Company description: Ranuan Kunta is a municipal organization located in Ranualla, Finland, dedicated to providing a range of construction and development services. The company's mission is to enhance the local community through effective urban planning and infrastructure development, ensuring sustainable growth and improved living conditions for its residents. Ranuan Kunta collaborates with various partners, including local contractors and service providers, to deliver comprehensive solutions in construction, maintenance, and urban development. Its target market includes local businesses, residents, and governmental entities seeking reliable and efficient construction services. By focusing on community needs and fostering partnerships, Ranuan Kunta aims to create a vibrant and sustainable environment for all its stakeholders.

Name: GoSleep
Company description: Welcome to GoSleep - Premium pods for airports and workplaces. Whether you're at an airport waiting to catch your flight or at your workplace seeking a moment of rejuvenation, our innovative pods are designed to provide you with the ultimate comfort and privacy you deserve. Crafted with premium materials and equipped with advanced technology, our pods ensure that every moment of rest is maximized for your benefit. Visit our webpage to explore our range of premium pods and learn more about how GoSleep can transform your travel and work experience. Experience the future recharged with GoSleep and discover a new level of comfort and privacy wherever you go. Rest is more.

Name: Hotel Arthur
Company description: Hotel Arthur on yksityinen ja kodikas hotelli Helsingin keskustassa. Hotelli sijaitsee Helsingin päärautatieaseman läheisyydessä Kaisaniemessä. Helsingin tärkeimmät nähtävyydet, suuret tavaratalot, ravintolat, teatterit ja Casino Helsinki ovat vain kävelymatkan päässä. There is 203 rooms in the hotel and also 240 seated Restaurant Arthur Built in 1907, Hotel Arthur has 203 rooms and 400 beds. When you are looking for a location for conferences, Hotel Arthur’s individual conference rooms in downtown Helsinki are a great choice, we are easily accessible by all forms of public transport. Hotel Arthur accommodates almost 100,000 guests from Finland and abroad annually **** Follow us and find more: - Website: www.hotelarthur.fi - Facebook: /hotelarthurhelsinki - Instagram: /hotelarthur - Tripadvisor: / Arthur Hotel - Vkontakte: /hotel_arthur

Name: Northern Lights Village
Company description: At midnight, a white arctic fox dashes up the fells, trailing its tail through the snow shooting flickers into the sky. The aurora borealis burst into flame over the Northern Lights Village. Only the protective glass dome separates you and your warm bed from the sky and you feel like you are floating in the infinite expanse of space.

Name: Delfin
Company description: Delfin is a stylish source of foodservice and food merchandising ware. Our collections include metal, melamine, acrylic, ABS, and Bamboo. With a variety of materials, years of experience, a design savvy team and in-house manufacturing at our fingertips; Delfin can create innovative solutions for any situation. Name: Hotel Lilla Roberts
Company description: Hotel Lilla Roberts is a boutique hotel located in the heart of Helsinki, dedicated to promoting Finnish design through its innovative fashion partner concept. Since 2017, the hotel has collaborated with local designers, such as milliner Paula Kasu, to showcase unique, handcrafted fashion pieces that blend art and style. The hotel's mission is to provide guests with an exceptional experience that celebrates Finnish craftsmanship while offering exclusive benefits, such as special check-in perks for hotel guests. Targeting both leisure and business travelers, Hotel Lilla Roberts aims to create memorable escapes from everyday life, complemented by its modern cocktail bar, Bar Lilla e, and a commitment to ecological fashion. With a focus on community and collaboration, the hotel invites guests to immerse themselves in the vibrant local culture and design scene.

Name: Regatta SPA Hotel Hanko
Company description: Regatta SPA Hotel is a charming boutique hotel and SPA in Hanko, the most southern town in Finland. Famous Finnish architect Lars Sonck designed the hotel in 1898 and the totally renovated hotel reopened in 2012. Regatta SPA opened in April 2017. This exquisite hotel resort offers unique experiences and individual services for meetings and leisure.  48 unique rooms, 110 beds, in some of the spacious rooms a kitchenette, 2 suites.  A banquette hall for 30 – 100 persons, Lounge and Piazza for more informal gatherings. The new Regatta Spa is a unique spa resort which combines the seaside atmosphere of Hanko city and the varied services of a luxury spa to form a unique experience. You can pamper yourself next to the beautiful sea-shore, train with top instructors as well as delight in the tastes conjured up by our chef.

Name: Ravintolamestarit Oy
Company description: Ravintolamestarit Oy is a culinary company that operates the restaurant Musta Lammas, offering guests an unforgettable dining experience that transports them beyond the everyday. Led by the passionate and creative chef Jere Hakkarainen, the kitchen team at Musta Lammas crafts each dish with enthusiasm and innovation, ensuring a unique flavor journey for patrons. The company's mission is to provide exceptional culinary experiences in a captivating atmosphere, highlighted by the ambiance of its vaulted cellar. Targeting food enthusiasts and those seeking memorable dining moments, Ravintolamestarit Oy aims to create lasting impressions through its carefully curated menu and inviting environment. The restaurant's commitment to quality and creativity positions it as a sought-after destination for both locals and visitors alike.

Name: Home Hotel Katajanokka
Company description: Home Hotel Katajanokka is ready to fulfil the expectations of travellers looking for exceptional quality. Inside the old brick walls, a fascinating world of contrasts opens up - a modern premier-class hotel built in a historic prison setting. The red brick walls house 106 magnificent and luxurious rooms. Stylish decor and a unique atmosphere effectively take your mind off the busy working day and intensive trip. The thick walls ensure a good night's sleep and first class conveniences are available to meet even the most demanding requirements. Restaurant Linnankellari provides food enthusiasts with a fine selection of delicious meals, with the old jail setting adding an exotic touch to the experience. Try a relaxing drink after work or an outstanding full-course meal.

Name: Hotel U14
Company description: Hotel U14, Marriott Autograph Collection is a new family owned boutique-hotel located in the heart of Helsinki, opening 9th of March 2020. Unioninkatu 14, 00130 Helsinki.

Company description: Långvik Congress Wellness Hotel is located in the seaside setting of Kirkkonummi – just half an hour from Helsinki and the Helsinki-Vantaa Airport. The internationally high-glass hotel offers you a luxurious stay, culinary moments and spa treatments in the middle of the beautiful Finnish nature.

Name: Visit Inari - Safaris & Accommodation
Company description: Visit Inari Safaris & Accommodation is family owned, private company providing tourism services in Inari region year-around.  We offer accommodation in Visit Inari Hotel and Visit Inari Holiday Village.  From our services you'll find suitable solution for many needs. Our Aurora restaurant offers you tasty experience with good food and perfect location in the middle of Inari village and view to Lake Inari. We have a long experience on safari production and we have a wide selection of different activities year around.  One of our specialties is the Cruise on Lake Inari during the summer and autumn time.  Add to activities we also provide transfers from Inari-Saariselka area to Kirkenes airport and Hurtigruten. Come and experience more with us.

Name: Nuorisokeskus Marttinen Youth Centre Marttinen
Company description: Mikä Marttinen on? Meille yhteiskunnallinen työ on tärkeää – etenkin lapset ja nuoret. Marttinen on yksi Suomen kymmenestä opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriön tukemista ja valvomista valtakunnallisista nuorisokeskuksista. Perustehtävämme on tukea nuorten (0-29-vuotiaiden) kasvua ja kehitystä. Pedagogisen osaamisen ja toiminnallisten menetelmien kautta nuoret saavat meiltä hyödyllisiä kokemuksia yksin ja ryhmässä toimimisesta. Yhteishengen muodostuminen, ongelman ratkaisu porukalla ja itsensä voittaminen ovat muutamia niistä ainutlaatuisista asioista, joihin meillä tähdätään. Kokouksia, seminaareja, virkistyspäiviä, koiraleirejä... Marttinen on myös suosittu juhlien, kokousten ja virkistyspäivien pitopaikka ympäri vuoden. Keskus sijaitsee Virroilla kulttuurihistoriallisesti arvokkaalla alueella kauniin vesistön ympäröimänä, jonka korkeimmalla paikalla komeilee vuonna 1892 rakennettu Marttisen Vanha Pappila upeine saleineen. Vuosittain useat hääparit viettävät ikimuistoista juhlapäiväänsä Pappilassa läheistensä kanssa. Käyttämällä Marttisen palveluita olette edesauttamassa yhteiskunnallista tehtäväämme sekä lasten ja nuorten hyvää tulevaisuutta! Youth Centre Marttinen is located in Virrat in the middle of Finland. Marttinen is surrounded by very varying nature with many lakes and forests. The Center offers non-formal education for young people from 0 to 29-years old. Marttinen is an excellent choise for camp schools, youth camps and acitivities all over the year for children and youngsters under 29-years old. In addition of the youth work the center has excellent facilities for having family, parties, weddings and conferenes in the fascinating Old Virage of Marttinen.

Name: Metsäkartano Youth Centre - Nuorisokeskus Metsäkartano
Company description: Come and join a wilderness adventure in the shadows of the forest in Metsäkartano Youth Centre and Nature Holiday Resort, where the air is as clean as it can get and where you really can hear the sound of nature. Experience a guided nature snowshoe expedition or hiking through forest trails, and take a moment to rest by a campfire. Feel the life rushing in your veins after dipping in a refreshing lake, or have the gentle waves rock your canoe on a warm summer day. Metsäkartano wilderness centre is a stunning retreat situated in Finland’s Lakeland region, only 1,5 hours from central Kuopio. Specialising in groups, we provide the perfect setting for a fabulous holiday or a camp adventure. You will enjoy many exciting outdoor experiences among vast forests, tranquil lakes and rivers which weave in and out of the lush countryside. Everyone will love discovering many surprises found in the great outdoors as they embark on fun activities together all year. Youth camp, camp school or nature holiday - which one is it for you? Metsäisten harjujen suojassa ja kimaltelevan erämaajärven rannalla, luonnonkauniissa niemessä sijaitseva Nuorisokeskus Metsäkartano on todellinen kätketty aarre! Tämä upea paikka tarjoaa unohtumattoman miljöön leireille, perhejuhlille ja kokouksille sekä luontolomille. Läheinen Tiilikkajärven kansallispuisto ja muut Rautavaaran upeat luontokohteet, sijainti kolmen maakunnan rajamailla ja lyhyt 1,5 tunnin matka Kuopiosta mahdollistavat sen, että pääset helposti irti arjesta, mitä puhtaimman luonnon ääreen - kokemaan unohtumattomia luontoelämyksiä. Ne, jotka kerran löytävät tiensä Metsäkartanolle, palaavat sinne yhä uudelleen - oletko sinä seuraava? Suomenkieliset verkkosivut: https://www.metsakartano.com/

Name: Hotelli-Ravintola Alma
Company description: Hotelli-Ravintola Alma consists of three different style of buildings right next to Seinäjoki railway station. Main building has 160 seats restaurant in old railroad house from 1909, renovated in 2006 to restaurant, hotel rooms and meeting rooms. Old water tower from 1920´s renovated 2015 as hotel room; 6 Junior Suites with Sauna and Tower Suite with sauna and bath tub. New Tower, built 2020, holds 52 rooms, including two Executive Suites and meeting rooms, one with sauna. Altogether 79 hotel rooms and 13 meeting rooms.

Name: Virkistyshotelli Yyteri
Company description: Hotellimme tarina juontaa juurensa aina kuusikymmenluvun lopulle, jolloin pitkään haaveiltu hotellihanke Yyterin rannoille nytkähti viimein liikkeelle. Silloinen Rantaloma Oy rakennutti Jan Söderlundin ja Erkki Valovirran suunnitteleman rakennuksen Rantasipi -ketjulle, ja hotelli valmistui 1974 nimellä Rantasipi Yyteri. Valmistuessaan hotelli oli Suomen korkeatasoisimpia, ja sen ravintoloihin mahtui jopa 2000 asiakasta ja se työllisti 110 henkeä. Huoneita valmistuneessa hotellissa oli 130. Hotelli ajautui 70-luvun lopulla vaikeuksiin ja Rantasipi luopui hotellista 1984. Uusien omistajien myötä nimi vaihtui pariinkin otteeseen ollen mm. Meriyyteri ja Merimaailma. 90-luvun alussa hotelli laajeni kylpyläosastolla ajan hengen mukaisesti ja nimeksi vaihtui Yyterin Kylpylähotelli. 2000-luku on ollut voimakasta hotellin tilojen uudistamisen aikaa, joka jatkuu yhä tänäpäivänä. Viimeisin laajennus, kahden lisäkerroksen rakentaminen, valmistui tammikuussa 2019, lisäten koko Yyterin alueelle ennennäkemättömän korkeatasoisia palveluita tilaussaunoineen, kattoterasseineen ja sviitteineen. NYT — JA HUOMENNA Seinien uudistuessa hotellin ydin on myös kypsynyt ja kehittynyt, ympäröivän Yyterin mukana – tätä muutosta säteilee nykyinen nimemme, Virkistyshotelli Yyteri. Haluamme uudistaa mielikuvia Yyteristä ja muistuttaa, että majesteettisen hiekkarannan lisäksi meillä on kaartuva taivas, eksoottinen rantaluonto ja aina aava meri. Yyterissä voit virkistyä levon ja rauhan merkeissä tai purskahdella ympäriinsä ja purkaa energiasi monipuolisten aktiviteettien parissa. Tai löytää monista vaihtoehdoista oman, ainutlaatuisen yhdistelmäsi. Hotellina valttikorttimme ovat selkeät. Olemme itsenäinen toimija, jolla on vapaus ja kyky reagoida nopeastikin mitä erilaisimpiin kysymyksiin ja muutoksiin. Majatalomainen toimintatapamme tarkoittaa aitoa välittämistä ja mutkatonta yhteistyötä. Tervetuloa virkistäytymään – teemme kaikkemme, että lähdet meiltä uutena iloisena versiona itsestäsi.

Company description: Evankeliointi-, diakonia- ja sielunhoitotyö Suomessa. Kansan Raamattuseura on evankeliumityöhön keskittyvä seurakuntien palvelujärjestö, joka on kristilliselle yhteistyölle avoin. Kansan Raamattuseuran päätoimipiste on Vivamon toimintakeskus Lohjalla. Name: Holiday Inn Hotels - Finland
Company description: Holiday Inn Hotels in Finland is dedicated to providing a welcoming and comfortable stay for both business and leisure travelers. With a mission centered on exceptional hospitality, the hotel focuses on delivering high-quality service and amenities tailored to the diverse needs of its guests. The hotel features modern accommodations, a well-equipped fitness center, and a variety of dining options, including the Bookmakers Restaurant & Lounge, where visitors can enjoy a fresh morning buffet and sumptuous evening dining.  Targeting a wide range of clientele, from corporate guests attending nearby business meetings to families exploring local attractions, Holiday Inn Hotels in Finland aims to create memorable experiences for all. The hotel emphasizes family-friendly services, highlighted by its "Kids Stay & Eat Free" program, which allows children 19 and under to stay free with their families and those 11 and under to eat for free.  In addition to its focus on guest comfort, the hotel collaborates with local businesses and event planners to provide tailored services for meetings and special occasions, reinforcing its commitment to customer satisfaction and community engagement. Conveniently located within walking distance to various shopping and dining options, the hotel also offers a complimentary local area shuttle service within five miles, enhancing accessibility for its guests.  Overall, Holiday Inn Hotels in Finland strives to deliver exceptional service and a relaxing environment, ensuring that every guest leaves with a positive and memorable experience.

Name: VillaGo
Company description: We offer high-class rental villas in Kirkkonummi, Finland for nature lovers, families and corporate guests. The first villa details 4 bedrooms, a bright, open-concept living room/kitchen, sauna and a large, partly covered terrace, complete with a hot tub. On the beach, we have a traditional, wood-heated Finnish sauna. Views to the sea and the unique nature of Morsfjärd. Opening in late 2020. Follow this space for further information!

Name: Matkailukeskus Kuopion Saana
Company description: Matkailukeskus Kuopion Saana is located in Kuopio, Eastern Finland, and more importantly, in the Bellanranta area that is known for its beautiful Lake Kallavesi scenery and wide range of cultural, sports and year-round activities. In Saana you can indulge all your senses. Our restaurant leans heavily on locally grown food to offer you a wide spectrum of spectacular tastes, and our pools pamper your skin together with the gentle steam of our saunas. You can also enjoy the magnificent view from our restaurant and terraces and be enthralled by the nostalgic scent of our smoke sauna mixing subtly with the exquisite aromas from our kitchen. You can come to Saana to refresh yourself, nourish your body and soul, relax, celebrate and to hold a meeting or seminar. We are also happy to tailor special theme days for you and your group with our large network of partners. Right next door to us you can find several adventure services, a high-quality gym and group-fitness room, an indoor karting track as well as a multi-training centre, sports equipment rental shop, mini-golf course and a brewery that offers tours. In addition, Lake Kallavesi provides a terrific setting for different boat cruises, canoeing trips or for example standup paddleboarding polo. We at Saana aim to provide you and your group a magnificent time and memorable moments whether you are just dropping in or spending the entire day in the area. You are warmly welcome – Saana and its saunas are waiting for you! Name: Hotel Helka
HQ Location: Finland, Uusimaa, Helsinki, 23 Pohjoinen Rautatiekatu, fi-00100
Company description: Helka on ainutlaatuinen, Helsingin keskustassa sijaitseva 1920-luvulla rakennettu hotelli. Asiakaspalvelu on meille helkaisille intohimo ja onnellisuutenne on tärkein prioriteettimme. Panostamme sisustuksessamme suomalaisiin klassikoihin, kuten Aaltoon ja Artekiin. Hotellissamme on 150 tyylikästä ja mukavaa huonetta. Viisikerroksisesta hotellistamme löytyy kolme erilaisiin käyttötarkoituksiin sopivaa kokoustilaa 10-60 henkilölle. Lemmikkieläimet ovat myös tervetulleita Helkaan.  Omistajamme Suomen NNKY-liitto perusti hotellin vuonna 1969. Yhä tänä päivänä Helkan tuotot ohjataan NNKY:n kautta tyttöjen ja naisten hyväksi tehtävään työhön. Nauttimalla Helkan palveluista teet samalla hyvää. Hotelli Helka on syrjinnästä vapaa alue. Hotel Helka is a unique private hotel in the heart of Helsinki, built in an old 1920s building. For us, its all about you. We are passionate about customer service and making you happy is always our first priority.  Our stylish interior is decorated with carefully chosen Finnish design classics such as Alvar Aalto and Artek, to name a few. All in all, we have 150 rooms on five floors where design and functionality are well combined. Our three meeting rooms  accommodates from 10 to 60 people and are suitable for many occasions. Pets are also welcome to Helka.  The hotel was founded 1969 by one of the oldest women’s organizations in Finland (YWCA of Finland). Today, Helka is still owned by the YWCA, whose goal, among others, is to empower girls and women and to promote human rights. The profits of Hotel Helka are directed to YWCA’s work for girls and women in Finland and abroad. So, you also can do good by being our guest in Hotel Helka. Helka is a discrimination-free zone.

Name: Hotel F6
Company description: This unique boutique hotel is all about service. Our staff is here for the guest. Hotel F6 is a family owned hotel and also all of us, the staff, are like a family. We have used high quality materials, not just for style but also for sustainability as we care about the environment. This shows in all of our choices, for example, our electricity is produced with wind and water.

Company description: Borgo I Vicelli adults only relais, è un villa rinascimentale, agriturismo e borgo diffuso immerso tra le colline del Chianti, circondato da una tenuta coltivata ad olivi, con spa e piscina. Una location unica ed esclusiva per viaggi su misura e lune di miele romantiche.

Name: Kyyhkylä Wellbeing Resort
Company description: Kyyhkylä Wellbeing Resort is surrounded by wonderful and peaceful nature, located on the shores of Lake Saimaa in Mikkeli. You are welcome to stay as long as you want and take in the unique mansion environment or enjoy our wellness services, restaurants and cafe. Offering unforgettable experiences, Kyyhkylä Wellbeing Resort offers a wide selection of wellness services fit for guests of all ages, all year round. Annila Golf Course is also nearby! During the winter, the same landscapes are transformed into a wintry paradise; inviting you to ski, snowshoe, hike or enjoy a toasty campfire experience in a hut.  Our restaurants serve quality, local ingredients. After dinner, it’s always a wonderful idea to go for a hot steam in the sauna and go for a dip in Lake Saimaa, regardless of the season. Our resort is located 7km from Mikkeli Market Square, offering accommodations to suit your desires and needs; including the wellness oasis, the hotel and the mansion whose walls have more than a few stories to tell. You are most warmly welcome to be our guest!

Choose from a collection of contemporary, move-in ready studios, or opt for a more affordable room with just the essentials. With a passion for making you feel at home, our staff and services allow you to concentrate on life itself.

Our yard consists of three traditional log buildings, which were originally made by hand in North Karelia and were later moved to Kelvänsaari. We started offering accommodation after a long 12-year break in 2021. For us, Tarina-Aho is a place that combines nature, Lake Pielinen, peace of mind, the simplicity of things and the North Karelian tradition. Arriving at Tarina-Aho is like a trip back in time - busy everyday life and worries remain on the mainland as you board the boat.

Name: Camp Land Oy
Company description: Camp Land offers a five-star camping experience for people who love both nature and quality. Our most important values are reflected in respect for the natural environment, Finnish luxury and holistic design. Respect for the natural environment Camp Land tents do not damage the environment. They do not require cracking, drainage pipes or landscaping. When we take a tent away, the area around it remains as intact as it was before the tent was put up. The Finnish outdoors is for everyone to enjoy. Public access rights allow for many options, including temporary accommodation, collecting mushrooms and berries, and fishing, regardless of who owns the land. We want to honour this unique freedom and teach our customers to enjoy Finland’s natural areas responsibly.  Finnish luxury We use local Finnish products whenever possible. The tents are made by hand in Finland out of strong, flexible, and sustainable Finnish spruce.  We offer our customers meals made from fresh, clean, and high-quality raw Finnish ingredients. Our suppliers and service providers, such as travel companies, food companies and haulage companies, are all local Finnish businesses that can be trusted.  Holistic design We would like to offer you a starting point from which to experience the wilderness of the north. You will see nature so close that you become part of it, but without any reduction in comfort. All of your senses will be alert and you will feel energized. To achieve this, every aspect of the tents is of the highest quality from beginning to end.

Name: Lapland Welcome Ltd
Company description: Lapland Welcome is a pioneer company in Lapland, which has been providing nature holidays and activities in Finland for about 20 years. We are called Nature and Aurora Experts of Lapland, merged with the talented activity organizer. We have been awarded by TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence since 2015 every year.  We offer a wide variety of holiday packages, programmes and accommodation throughout Finland and Lapland. From the Northern Lights to Icebreaker cruises, we arrange unique and unforgettable experiences both for individuals and groups, all year round. Located in Rovaniemi – the capital of Finnish Lapland – we are a registered package tour operator and an incoming travel agency, a destination management company (DMC) and an activity programme provider. Whether you wish to see the Northern Lights, experience snowmobile riding, husky trips, reindeer safaris or reserve any services in Lapland, we will arrange all the elements of your package holiday with meticulous care, allowing you to concentrate on having fun. There are many ready-made packages to choose in wintertime and summertime. Particularly popular with visitors is the Aurora hunting, a guided tour where you go out on a search for the Northern Lights. Lapland Welcome offers Northern Lights trips every evening from August 21st to April 21st, taking you to the best viewing locations. In summertime, we offer our famous Moose Spotting Safaris, where you have a chance to see the biggest wild animals in Europe, in the heart of nature! Make your stay in Finland and Lapland even more enjoyable! Let us plan the details!

Picture perfect interior and architecture, beautiful nature, true boutique service, fresh food and carefully selected wines.   Accommodation, spa, team days, meetings, events, private dining, pr-events, catering and shoot locations.

Name: Levi White House
Company description: Showcasing two bedrooms, a barbecue, sauna and year around outdoor hot tub LEVI White House is located in Levi, Finland. Äkäslompolo is 38.6 km away. Kittilä is 17.7 km from LEVI White House. The nearest airport is Kittila Airport, 12.9 km from the property. An airport shuttle bus runs from the Kittilä airport to Levi after all scheduled flights throughout the year. The bus departs once the luggage has been cleared. The bus also runs from Levi to the airport before the flights. Schedule enquiries: www.tunturilinjat.fi or Levi tourist information (+358 16 639 3378).  Levi Ski Bus stop number 13 is just two minutes walk from the Levi White House front door. On high season busses freaquent every 30 minutes from early morning till evening. Taxi to Levi village costs approximately 14 euros.    Free private parking is available on site.The accommodation is fitted with a big flat-screen TV.  There is also a kitchen, equipped with a microwave, toaster and refrigerator. A stovetop and coffee machine are also provided. Bed linen are available. LEVI White House also includes a sun terrace. Free WiFi is available. AV services include Samsung Smart TV apps, Apple TV and Chromecast.

Levi Suites Levin Klubi is the place for an active holiday, location nearby Levi golf and ski lift number 6. Ski-in ski-out apartments are also a great place to hunt northern lights. In the summer time you may start your golf round almost from your door step. Let us help you to create your drem vacation or meeting arrangements. Our luxury apartments are located in Unna Mànnu, Levi center, above the all ordinary. Check our website Levisuites.fi and learn more about the apartments and services.

Name: VB Experience
Company description: When you want to compound motorsports, nature, and unbelievable experiences from the beauty of Arctic Lapland to F1 Grand Prix weekends, this experience family is for you. If you have dreamed to visit the Arctic North, the Arctic Edition is your choice. It takes you above the Arctic Circle to Finnish Lapland and an area called Kilpsijärvi, where we have our own hideaway. Here you will breathe the world’s purest air, meet reindeers, drive a snowmobile through the Arctic scenery, visit the highest peak in Finland, Halti, and much more. Our second tailored experience is the Grand Prix edition. This all-inclusive experience gives you an opportunity to choose your favorite GP from the F1 race calendar and enjoy the race weekend in a completely new way. Our personal hospitality team manages everything from accommodation to ground transportation and race tickets of your choice. The third part of this experience family is built around our own passion project OATH Gin. We are delighted to offer you a bespoke and exclusive lounge experience, and the Lounge is accessible for the event of your choice. The concept of OATH Lounge is based on the vision, to provide unforgettable experiences, no matter the occasion or location. The fourth member of the family is the Gravel edition. It can be tailored to be your ultimate cycling experience. From Finnish Lapland to mountain routes in Souther France you can share this with us.

Name: Arctos Lapland
Company description: We are a young Finnish-Dutch couple who fell in love with Lapland. We organise private Arctic spa experiences on the beautiful shore of lake Norväjärvi, just 15 minutes away from Rovaniemi central and Santa Clause village. You are welcome to enjoy our traditional wood-heated sauna, relax in the hot tub, take a dip in the frozen lake and grill some snacks in a typical Lappish hut.   We believe a spa should be enjoyed without a rush so there is plenty of time to enjoy this authentic experience with your private group. During the day session, you can experience the Arctic beauty to its fullest. Straight from the sauna and hot tub, you have a perfect view of the frozen lake. It’s time to recharge body & soul on your well-deserved relaxing day. When the days in Lapland are getting shorter, the nights are getting cosier. Candles and cosy lighting turn the spa area into a magical place at night. Our hot tub is facing the Northern sky making it the perfect place for Northern Lights spotting if the sky is clear.
